comments.value:
I can confirm that this bug with the status sticking still exists. I experienced it May ‎9, ‎2026 while in VR. Both accounts are VRChat accounts. The status bug also persisted for me after joining another instance, and didn't resolve itself until I closed and reopened VRChat again under the same account.

I tried to replicate the bug again today (May 14th, 2026), but on desktop instead of in VR. And instead of the status from the other account sticking, the names of the world favorite folders of the other account stuck instead? The other account doesn't have VRC+, so I could only see 4 world favorite tabs.

But then after waiting a bit and opening the worlds tab directly from the quick menu and not from another tab in the main menu, the world favorites on my VRChat account that has VRC+ now has its regular folder names and all 4 regular + 4 VRC+ world favorite folders came back.

This bug seems to be evasive, I think it might be a bug related to signing into one account that doesn't have VRC+, then signing back into the account that has VRC+. 

The world favorites folder name bug (on desktop) was one I got today by: 

1 - Sign into the account that has VRC+

2 - log out within 2 minutes (not leaving home world)

3 - log back into a VRChat account that doesn't have VRC+

4 - log out again within 2 minutes (not leaving home world)

5 - Log into the account that has VRC+ again

6 - Open quick menu (still in home world)

7 - Go to settings tab -> Main menu

8 - Go to worlds tab -> My worlds -> Check favorite worlds list names.

Hope this helps for debugging this!

details:
Status in top bar doesn't update after switching accounts

1. Set some status.

2. Switch accounts (Also switched from logging through Steam to logging through VRC).

3. The same status from #1 account is now stuck in the top bar on the #2 account.

4. Go back to #1 account.

5. Top bar effectively doesn't update anymore when you change the status again.
title: Status in top bar doesn't update after switching accounts
